meta.title: CarrierBridge pricing — from €0
meta.description: Discovery €0, Essential €79, Pro €199 per month. Public prices, direct sign-up, no sales call. Multi-site and large-account plans available.

page.h1: What does managing your transport rates cost?
page.lede: Public prices, no negotiation required. Discovery, Essential and Pro open with a simple sign-up. You move up a plan when your volumes justify it.
page.vatNote: All prices are shown excluding VAT, in euros.

tabs.enterpriseHint: Business and Enterprise: consolidation across sites, day-to-day operations, API.

discovery.name: Discovery
discovery.tagline: To check on your own rate sheets that the tool delivers.

essential.name: Essential
essential.tagline: For a single site leaving spreadsheets behind and taking back control of its surcharges.

pro.name: Pro
pro.tagline: For shippers who want to arbitrate every shipment and keep track of their carriers.

business.name: Business
business.tagline: To run day-to-day operations: requests, aggregation, assignment, spot rates.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.tagline: For groups consolidating several sites, flows and carriers.

connectors.label: ERP/TMS connectors, automatic retrieval of transport orders

roi.title: What the subscription represents against the transport budget
roi.disclaimer: Indicative estimate, based on an assumption of 4% saved on the annual transport budget. It is not a guarantee of results and depends on your starting position.

items.essential: Transport budget €150,000 — 4% saved = €6,000 a year, roughly 8 times the annual subscription.
items.pro: Transport budget €500,000 — 4% saved = €20,000 a year, 10 times the annual subscription.
items.business: Transport budget €1.2M — 4% saved = €48,000 a year, close to 11 times the annual subscription.
items.enterprise: Transport budget €3M — 4% saved = €120,000 a year, 10 times the annual subscription.

tenders.lede: Charged per tender, separately from the subscription. The Enterprise plan includes one simple tender a year.

onboarding.tagline: For teams that want someone who knows both the transport trade and the tool.

items.name: Kick-off
items.details: Loading your rate sheets, setting up your indexation formulas, hands-on start.

items.name: Secure
items.summary: Five days of support spread over 12 months.
items.details: Full carrier register set-up, advanced configuration, tender scoping, quarterly reviews.
items.note: Unused days are not carried beyond 12 months.

items: Discovery, Essential and Pro open with a simple sign-up: two fields, no contact form, no sales call.
Business, Enterprise, Secure onboarding and connectors are scoped in a conversation, because the scope drives the price.
An annual commitment gives you two months free compared with paying monthly.
AI sourcing is in beta: it is included in Pro and Business, and is never charged separately.
